solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

S050-01.notes: 'Although...promising, careful not to overstate them, noting small/short trial' is coherent. A dismiss: contradicts the caution logic (the caveats are reasons not to overclaim, not reasons not to dismiss). B replicate: researchers would want replication; the caveats don't argue against it. C conceal: caveats about sample size don't relate to hiding results.

S050-02.notes: Sentence 2 establishes the ferry was taken for granted, setting up the surprising outcry. A: literal misreading; 'no longer noticed' means habituation, not faintness. C: no county rationale given. D: contradicted by the letters demanding it be saved.

S050-03.notes: Only heavy rain removes the inhibitor, so seeds avoid sprouting after light rain that can't sustain seedlings. B contradicts the passage. C and D: predation and seed weight/wind aren't discussed and don't follow from the rinse-out mechanism.

S050-04.notes: Math checks: 30,000/50,000 = 60%; 30,000/120,000 = 25%. Each city gained 30,000. C addresses both parts of the claim. A: only city A, no comparison. B: absolute size only. D: absolute gap (70,000 is correct), irrelevant to growth rate.

S050-05.notes: 'The museum's newest gallery, which opened in March, has already drawn...' closes the nonrestrictive clause with a comma to match the opening comma. B leaves the clause unclosed (the 'March has' run-on). C: a semicolon separates subject from verb. D: a dash mismatches the opening comma.

S050-06.notes: Singular subject 'tradition' (with intervening 'sandcastles', 'children') -> 'continues'. A and C are plural and fall for the nearby plural nouns. B: a participle leaves no finite main verb, so it's a fragment.

S050-07.notes: The final sentence is an inference from the gap between early and later accounts: 'Evidently' fits. A Consequently: the later surveys didn't cause the explorers to see only the entrance hall. C Similarly: no parallel claim. D Nonetheless: no contrast; the sentence explains the discrepancy instead of conceding against it.

S050-08.notes: The goal needs the research finding (slower regrowth with age) plus orienting context for an unfamiliar audience. C gives both: it identifies axolotls as salamanders from near Mexico City that regrow limbs. A states the finding but never says what an axolotl is. B and D give background but leave out the finding.

S050-09.notes: Math checks: 0.20*800 = 160; 0.30*200 = 60. A gives both counts and acknowledges the smaller percentage, matching both parts of the claim. B: rural only. C: urban only, no comparison. D: the combined total (220) and population share don't compare the groups' yes counts.

S050-10.notes: D gives the shared features: both drain tropical rainforests and both are the top two by water volume. A: a difference (length). B: Congo only. C: emphasizes the Amazon's superiority, a difference. 'Anywhere on Earth' slightly extends 'any other river' but is harmless in a distractor.
